[SWS_CRYPT_00504]
⌈
If CreateRandomGeneratorCtx() is called to
create a local-state RandomGeneratorCtx with initialize set to true, the internal
state of the created RandomGeneratorCtx shall be seeded by FC Crypto before
returning.
⌋
